about.description:
SAC (Seismic Analysis Code) is a general purpose interactive program
designed for the study of sequential signals, especially time series
data. It is used in seismology for reading and writing binary seismic
data files, for filtering, spectral analysis and deconvolution, and for
interactive display of waveforms.

This is the community maintained continuation of SAC. In addition to the
`sac` interpreter the package contains the `saclst`, `sacswap`, `sgftops`,
`bbfswap` and `sgfswap` utilities, the headers, and the auxiliary data
(colour tables, travel-time tables, macros, ...) in the `aux` and `macros`
directories of the installation prefix. SAC finds that data through the
`SACAUX` environment variable, which is compiled into the binaries; the
`bin/sacinit.sh` and `bin/sacinit.csh` scripts set `SACHOME`, `SACAUX` and
`PATH` for a session.

The static libraries needed to link programs against SAC are in the
separate `sac-static` package.
about.license: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND LGPL-3.0-or-later
about.license_family: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND LGPL-3.0-or-later

script:
printf 'fg impulse npts 100 delta 0.01
w test.sac
quit
' > commands.m
test "$(saclst delta npts f test.sac | awk '{$1=$1};1')" = "test.sac 0.01 100"

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "103.0"

recipe:
  name: sac
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/EarthScope/sac-community/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f61fbe30d0411fe3033bdb76731062da24940c27920338d0f91a867842b791b8

build:
  number: 0
  # Upstream's Visual Studio project (win/) predates the current source layout
  # and no longer builds, so Windows is not supported yet.
  skip:
    - win

outputs:
  - package:
      name: sac
    build:
      script: build.sh
      files:
        include:
          - "**"
        # The static archives are in the sac-static output (CFEP-18), and
        # with them sac-config, which only emits linker flags.
        exclude:
          - lib/libsac.a
          - lib/libsacio.a
          - lib/sacio.a
          - bin/sac-config
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - libcurl
        - libxml2-devel
        - xorg-libx11
        - xorg-libxpm
        - xorg-xorgproto
        - zlib
    tests:
      - script:
          - printf 'fg impulse npts 100 delta 0.01\nw test.sac\nquit\n' > commands.m
          - sac commands.m
          - test "$(saclst delta npts f test.sac | awk '{$1=$1};1')" = "test.sac 0.01 100"
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            - sac
            - sacinit.sh
            - saclst
            - sacswap
            - sgftops
          include:
            - sac.h
            - sacio.h
          files:
            exists:
              - aux/messages
              - macros/init.m
              - lib/README_lib
            not_exists:
              - lib/libsac.a
              - lib/libsacio.a
              - lib/sacio.a
              - bin/sac-config

  - package:
      name: sac-static
    build:
      script: build.sh
      files:
        - lib/libsac.a
        - lib/libsacio.a
        - lib/sacio.a
        - bin/sac-config
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - libcurl
        - libxml2-devel
        - xorg-libx11
        - xorg-libxpm
        - xorg-xorgproto
        - zlib
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('sac', exact=True) }}
      # Static archives need nothing at runtime.
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - libcurl
          - libxml2-devel
          - xorg-libx11
          - xorg-libxpm
          - xorg-xorgproto
          - zlib
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            exists:
              - lib/libsac.a
              - lib/libsacio.a
              - lib/sacio.a
              - bin/sac-config
            not_exists:
              - bin/sac
      - script:
          - printf '#include <sacio.h>\nint main(void) { return 0; }\n' > link.c
          - $CC $(sac-config -c) link.c $(sac-config -l sacio) -o link
          - ./link
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    about:
      summary: Static libraries of SAC (Seismic Analysis Code)
      description: |
        Static archives of the SAC libraries (`libsac.a`, `libsacio.a` and the
        `sacio.a` compatibility name), for linking user programs against SAC,
        e.g. the tools in `utils/` that ship with the `sac` package:

            $(sac-config -c) mytool.c $(sac-config -l sacio) -o mytool

        The headers are in the `sac` package, which this package depends on.
